title: The Verification Crisis: Expert Perceptions of GenAI Disinformation and the Case for Reproducible Provenance
abstract: arXiv:2602.02100v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The growth of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) has shifted disinformation production from manual fabrication to automated, large-scale manipulation. This article presents findings from the first wave of a longitudinal expert perception survey (N=21) involving AI researchers, policymakers, and disinformation specialists. It examines the perceived severity of multimodal threats -- text, image, audio, and video -- and evaluates current mitigation strategies. Results indicate that while deepfake video presents immediate "shock" value, large-scale text generation poses a systemic risk of "epistemic fragmentation" and "synthetic consensus," particularly in the political domain. The survey reveals skepticism about technical detection tools, with experts favoring provenance standards and regulatory frameworks despite implementation barriers. translated_title: 验证危机：专家对生成式人工智能虚假信息的认知及可复现溯源的必要性论证
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能的发展已使虚假信息的生产从人工编造转向自动化的大规模操纵。本文报告了一项针对人工智能研究人员、政策制定者和虚假信息专家的纵向专家认知调查（N=21）第一波的研究结果。研究考察了多模态威胁——文本、图像、音频和视频——的感知严重程度，并评估了当前的缓解策略。结果表明，虽然深度伪造视频具有即时的“冲击”价值，但大规模文本生成构成了“认知碎片化”和“合成共识”的系统性风险，尤其是在政治领域。调查揭示了专家对技术检测工具的怀疑态度，尽管存在实施障碍，专家们更倾向于支持溯源标准和监管框架。GenAI虚假信息研究需要可复现的方法。当前的挑战是……
tldr: 专家调查显示，深度伪造视频虽具即时冲击力，但大规模文本生成带来的“认知碎片化”和“合成共识”才是更大的系统性风险，专家更倾向于支持可复现的溯源标准和监管框架，而非技术检测工具。
en_tdlr: Expert survey findings reveal that while deepfake videos have immediate shock value, large-scale text generation poses systemic risks of "epistemic fragmentation" and "synthetic consensus," with experts favoring reproducible provenance standards and regulatory frameworks over technical detection tools.
